ProxyGroup.name: filters
ProxyGroup.SourceProxy:
This filter works in conjunction with a ttkForEach filter (2. input port) to perform pipeline iterations. Every time the ttkEndFor filter is executed, it checks the current and maximum iteration index of the ttkForEach filter and either request the next iteration or terminates the pipeline looping.
By default, the filter also aggregates its input data objects (1. input port) of every iteration in an internal vtkMultiBlockDataSet, which is finally provided as the filter output after the last iteration. For instance, if the for loop computes in each iteration a persistence diagram, then after n iterations the output of the ttkEndFor filter will consist of a vtkMultiBlockDataSet with n blocks, where block i is a shallow copy of the computed persistence diagram of iteration i. If the streamed aggregation over iterations is not desired (for example if this is too memory intensive or unnecessary) it can be disabled via the Aggregation property. If Aggregation is disabled, then the output of the ttkEndFor filter is just the output of the last iteration.
Online examples:
- https://topology-tool-kit.github.io/examples/cinemaIO/
